title: strengthhoney
description: This project add a new fluid and potion and a flower to craft the fluid called strengthoney
body: This is a mod that adds new things around a new fluid and potion called strengthhoney you get this honey through crafting 6 Strength flower 2 honeybottles and 1 water bucket to get strengthhoney than you brew that to get strengthoney potion![This is how you get strength honey potion]![picture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c56ef110286ac1ab756c84fe91a9374806496d54.png)
